center_quantization: nearest integer; ties to even, as upstream annotation rounding
peak_ties: nearest query center, then earliest frame
control: following annotated interval midpoint, same seven-frame window
pair_exclusion: unavailable windows; canonical overlaps another annotated beat window; control overlaps any annotated beat window
change_anchor: nearest annotated beat to each existing change point; ties earliest
ranking_direction: higher beat peak favors canonical over midpoint; higher downbeat head favors downbeat over non-downbeat
